messages:
emily: RFC follow-up: proposing an "adaptive smoke" onboarding flow to catch cache/KV regressions cheaply before doing full benches. Idea: three lanes - fast-lite, cache-stress, deep-regress.

vikram: can you sketch how artifacts get assigned? on upload vs after fast-lite?

emily: upload triggers fast-lite. if fast-lite passes, we enqueue cache-stress async. deep-regress is scheduled after cache-stress pass or on explicit trigger (enterprise, manual, or on-failure-review).

ben: how small is cache-stress? we need strict cost caps.

emily: target ~150k tokens across 400 sequences (stratified seqlen). two-phase sampling: 60% deterministic golden seeds, 40% reservoir from recent anonymized traces.

sara: we need compact metrics from cache-stress so runtime can make routing decisions. propose a 3-value vector: latency_ratio, cache_miss_delta, p95_tail.

emily: agree. name it meta.kv_health = [latency_ratio, miss_delta, p95_ms]. keep numeric and easy to compare.

jia: quantization: do we run cache-stress on every quant variant? that's expensive.

emily: run on FP32 canonical + default quant profile for the family. additional quant uploads get delta-check (fast-lite + compare kv_health delta). if delta > threshold -> gate to manual review.

vikram: what are pass thresholds? we should make them readable and configurable.

emily: draft thresholds: latency_ratio < 1.4, miss_delta < 0.03, p95_ms < baseline_p95 * 1.5, token-f1 (quality probe) > 0.90. open to tweaks.

ben: let's encode lanes declaratively so intake enforces budgets. sketch: ```yaml
onboard_lanes:
  fast-lite:
    budget_tokens: 6000
    checks: [tokenizer,sanity,short-latency]
  cache-stress:
    budget_tokens: 150000
    checks: [kv_health,seqlen-stratified,small-quality-probe]
    stratify_buckets: [1-32,33-128,129-512]
  deep-regress:
    budget_tokens: 4_000_000
    checks: [full-perf,regression-suite,quality-evals]
    triggers: [manual,cache-fail,scheduled-nightly]
```

sara: good. intake should also return a small JSON artifact with lane outcome + kv_health vector + artifact id, so runtime and rollout can consume it.

emily: agreed. propose intake emits: {artifact_id, lane, outcome:PASS|FAIL|WARN, kv_health, sample_seed_tag}. Keep fields flat.

vikram: i'll own intake schema + enforcement hook. i'll add a feature flag segmented_onboard and a per-tenant opt-in so we can rollout gradually.

jia: ben, can you prototype the sampling harness + cost estimator? we need to show ops the delta on monthly spend.

ben: on it. will also add an option to run cache-stress only on new-major-checkpoints (skip minor patches).

emily: rollout ops: default canary 2% traffic for 72h for models that pass cache-stress. if kv_health degrades in telemetry (p95 up > 2x or miss_delta > .05) -> auto-evict variant and rollback. enterprise tenants get manual approval gate.

sara: add retention policy for smoke results: keep full trace for 30d, compact kv_health time series for 1yr. Helps debugging regressions without keeping huge datasets.

emily: good point. also add audit log entry with intake user and job id for compliance.

onboard-bot: Ticket created: ML-ONB-4210 "Adaptive-smoke + cache-stress lane" (assignee: emily).

vikram: next steps: PR for intake schema (me), feature flag + opt-in (me), dashboard metrics (sara), sampling harness & cost sim (ben), pass/fail thresholds + quality probes (emily). meeting Thurs 11am to sync.

emily: thanks folks. will post a short doc with thresholds and examples of kv_health deltas. :thumbsup:
